False advertising / Wrong product received — Merach will not correct their mistake

I ordered a Merach StepMaster X, and my invoice clearly shows that the StepMaster X is the product I ordered. When I received the shipping notification, it also clearly stated that a StepMaster X would be shipped to me.

Instead, I received a sliding machine (Glide) — a completely different product.

I contacted Merach and, as requested, sent them photos showing exactly what I received. Despite having documentation showing what I ordered and what their shipping confirmation said would be shipped, Merach is now claiming that the sliding machine is what I ordered.

This is not what I ordered. I have the invoice and shipping confirmation to document this.

What is especially disappointing is that Merach has acknowledged the issue enough to request photos of the product I received, yet they have not issued a refund and have not provided me with an address or instructions to return the incorrect machine.

I should not have to fight with a company to correct an obvious fulfillment error. I simply want to return the product I did not order and receive a full refund for the StepMaster X that I actually purchased.

I would strongly recommend keeping screenshots of your order, invoice, and shipping confirmation if you purchase from Merach.

I will take this matter up with my credit card company.
